g.text: Figure 8a | Held-out observed and archived-factor reconstructed population activity

g.text: The same 603-neuron ordering, cue line and linear parula −2-to-+4 scale are used in both heatmaps.

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: Sixteen trials from one prespecified outer fold are averaged only for visualization. The ordering is determined from observed held-out activity and then frozen for the archived-factor reconstruction. Both panels use the

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: observed pre-cue baseline mean and SD. This is a downstream reconstruction display from archived factors, not native LFADS test-set performance.
